cache: none; every run reads and parses the selected files
estimator: ceil(Unicode characters / 4); a size estimate, not a model tokenizer

export.estimator: ceil(Unicode characters / 4); a size estimate, not a model tokenizer

fingerprint_scope: selected readable files and skip reasons, from current bytes; ignored files and secret contents are excluded
ranking: Aider-derived PageRank over identifier definitions and references; bare identifier text is matched, not a resolved call graph

rendering.whitespace: leading whitespace removed, including multiline literal lines; declaration sketch, not verbatim source
